subject.title: [Bug] Webchat avatar endpoint /avatar/{agentId} returns 404 even with valid IDENTITY.md avatar

question: Should local avatar failures keep the direct image route generic while improving UI/metadata diagnostics, or should `/avatar/{agentId}` expose more specific failure statuses such as oversized or missing?
rationale: The remaining behavior is both UX-visible and security-sensitive because it changes diagnostics for authenticated local workspace file serving and could reveal path, size, or policy details.

options.title: Improve UI Diagnostics Only
options.body: Keep direct image fetches generic and use existing metadata reasons plus Control UI surfaces to explain oversized, missing, unsupported, or outside-workspace avatars.

options.title: Expose Endpoint Errors
options.body: Return specific direct-route statuses such as 413 or 400 only after explicit security review proves no unsafe path or policy detail leaks.

options.title: Fold Into Remote Avatar Contract
options.body: Defer broader remote/local avatar policy choices to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/41201 while keeping this issue focused on local-file diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Improve UI Diagnostics Only
recommendation.body: Keep direct image fetches generic and use existing metadata reasons plus Control UI surfaces to explain oversized, missing, unsupported, or outside-workspace avatars.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest history signal for both the avatar feature and later local file-serving hardening.
